assumptions.A1_price_basis: AWS on-demand list prices, us-east-1, 2026-09-12; not spot, not negotiated, not measured here
assumptions.A2_hardware_mapping: latency measured on Apple M3 / RTX 2080 Ti, not on the priced instances; the 2080 Ti is faster than a T4, so GPU-path costs here are optimistic
assumptions.A3_worker_scaling: instance QPS = per-worker QPS x vCPU, i.e. perfect linear scaling. Optimistic: ADR-014 measured a 2.5x slowdown from one concurrent job, so real scaling is sublinear
assumptions.A4_serial_requests: one in-flight request per worker; the SLA is checked against the measured single-request p99

index_memory.note: float32; excludes Python container overhead and the id->row lookup dicts. Compare against peak_process_rss_gb for the whole-process figure.
